tools.name: match_class_request
tools.description: Read-only date, party-size and per-person budget matching against dated public-source classes. No personal data. Returns source candidates needing live verification, never live availability or a reservation.

tools.name: list_studios
tools.description: List studios in the referral catalog. All are public-source listings, not enrolled merchants.

tools.name: search_offerings
tools.description: Search classes/programs across the catalog. Optional filters: query (text), format (in_person_group, in_person_private, online, destination).

tools.name: get_booking_channel
tools.description: Get a studio's own public booking route. The consumer always books directly with the studio.

tools.name: create_referral
tools.description: Record an attributed referral lead for one offering and return the studio's own booking route. A lead record only: not a booking, not a completed visit, not a payable fee. Collects a first name only.

tools.name: get_referral
tools.description: Look up a recorded referral lead by id.
